name: Sunset Regalia (Lạc Hà Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Sky Goes One Colour (Nhất Sắc Thiên)
bonuses.rule: while you hold all three, once each fight after the 30th second, the glow over the field turns red for 8 s. The foe's Earth stacks count double for your arts, and you heal 3 % of your health each second.

story: The founder held all three. In 1179 Tô Vãn Chiếu pledged the Lone Duck Ring to Phan Vật Hoa for the loan that built the Cloud Bridge. The Regalia will be whole again when the loan is paid. The sect believes the ring is in the treasury vault.

name: Twin Swords of the Armoury (Võ Khố Song Kiếm)

bonuses.effect: Lightning and Frost (Tử Điện Thanh Sương)
bonuses.rule: each sword's sleeping element wakes for the holder of both, even without Thunder or Ice in the root, at half strength.

story: Forged by Thiệu Song Phong in 360 (C083) and parted at Chiết Kích Nguyên in 803 (C159). Held together, either sword would wake for a head with no Thunder and no Ice. This is why Tô Vãn Chiếu wants Thanh Sương back, and why Cảnh Trường Thiên is afraid she will ask him to fetch it.

name: Nails of Đào Sa (Đào Sa Đinh)

bonuses.rule: each needle that hits a foe carrying 3 or more Earth stacks pins one more; and when a foe hits you, your next needle volley at it is a certain crit (once every 6 s).

story: What the river gave back after 1173: the nails and the coat on the peg. Both are Lữ Tẫn Chu's. The reprisal half is the closest line until targets-tl/debt-stone exists.

name: Three Hundred Paces (Tam Bách Bộ)

bonuses.rule: while you carry a poison or miasma stack, your sword arts are 15 % faster, and each sword hit sheds one poison stack from you.

story: The veil she walked in with and the sword her father gave her when she walked out, both steeped by Tào Mộ Tử's hand. Hình Lạc Nhạn holds both.

name: Prize and Brush (Ấn Bút Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Glow After Dark (Hà Quang Bất Tán)
bonuses.rule: a talisman you seal with the Crane Shoal Seal keeps its glow; if it expires unspent, it fires once at half strength at the foe.

story: The brush the head gave her at birth and the prize it won at fourteen. Tô Mộ Vân holds both but, at Luyện Khí, can wear only one: she wears the seal, and the set waits for her foundation.

name: Debt and Wall (Trái Bích Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Every Debt Called (Hữu Trái Tất Hoàn)
bonuses.rule: the Tally counts damage you block as well as damage you take, and may be called twice a fight; each call also gives you a shield the size of the damage it returns.

story: His wife's tally, his father's copper and the old treasury's door: what Trầm Tịch Dương has counted on for five centuries. All three are his. The Mirror of the Second Seat stays in the treasury hall, unworn while he wears the wall.

name: What Came Off the Field (Chiết Kích Di Vật)

bonuses.rule: while your One Colour field stands, you take 10 % less damage; the first time you are Wounded inside it, the Cold Geese Sword gains two blades for the rest of the fight.

story: A sword from the dead's halberds, an empty scabbard and his master's coat: the three things Cảnh Trường Thiên carried off Chiết Kích Nguyên. He holds all three. The share-the-damage half is the closest line until targets-tl/geese-line exists.

name: The Envoy's Errand (Sứ Giả Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: a foe struck by the fan's art at 4 or more Earth stacks has its guard broken (its block and ward 30 % weaker for 4 s), and each guard you break this way lets your song heal you for 2 % of your health.

story: Her master's fan, her own fare and the vassals' stitches: Hách Ánh Hà's whole errand. All three are hers.

name: The Cloud Bridge Works (Vân Kiều Tam Cụ)

bonuses.rule: while you hold both Flag charges, each time the foe acts it gains 2 Earth stacks and one Slowed Time stack (once per 2 s); while you are Composed, your array's upkeep costs no linh lực.

story: The flags, the anchor-pin and the lamp of the miners: everything Quách Tiếp Vân took from Vân Kiều to build the bridge. All three are his.

name: The Miasma Watch (Thủ Chướng Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Outlast the Grey (Trì Cửu Hôi Trung)
bonuses.rule: while the Lantern burns green, each poison stack that fades from you heals you 1 % of your health over 3 s and adds one Earth stack to your next anchor hit; a foe at 6 Earth stacks is locked in place for 1.5 s (once per foe every 12 s).

story: The warden's lantern, anchor and coat, all made in 806 and handed from warden to warden. Hình Trọng Sơn holds all three; whoever keeps the Watch after him inherits the set.
